description: This header file defines a function within the 'gfxstream' namespace that executes a given function in a subprocess and performs a check for crashes or aborts. It declares the function 'DoWithSubprocessCheck' which runs a provided callback with a timeout, returning an 'expected' type indicating success or failure.

methods.name: DoWithSubprocessCheck
methods.description: Executes a function in a subprocess to check for crashes or aborts, then runs it in the current process if the subprocess check succeeds. Accepts a callback function and an optional timeout duration, returning an 'expected' type indicating success or error message.
